_about: Curated aggregate numbers quoted on index.html. Every entry is copied from a completed local experiment's results.json and its written final report. Synthetic observing-system simulation experiments (OSSEs) on a real static river topology; no measured chemistry. Raw arrays, logs and reports are not published.

_network.caveat: Provisional outlet component, not a validated Mississippi study boundary.

neural_decay_series._design: 13-parameter network: latitude and log K -> 3 tanh hidden units -> bounded log decay rate. Analytic synthetic truth; no decay-rate labels in training. Water, chemical inputs, K, X fixed; storage anomaly zero. Concentrations perturbed with 20% CV lognormal noise except where noted.

cases.label: NN, 30 noise-free gauges, weight precision 0.1
cases.note: Observations equal the noiseless truth; the fitting sigma stays at the assumed 20% CV.

per_sample_data_misfit._note: 0.5 is the level a correctly specified model reaches under the assumed noise. Raw cost scales with sample count, so only per-sample numbers are comparable.

_caveats: Each row is one seed, one initialization, one noise realization.
The 30-gauge, 90-gauge, noise-free and stronger-prior rows change DIFFERENT factors; they are not a single controlled ladder.
Evaluation gauges are a fixed, repeatedly used set on the same known network, not a blind test and not independent-catchment generalization.
Truth is analytic and generated by the same physics used to fit it; rate labels exist only for evaluation.

joint_snapshot._design: Five reduced parameters only: two chemical-input scalings, two decay rates, one storage-anomaly amplitude. Noise-free observations; sigma_log = 0.19804 is an assumed fitting scale, not the generated noise.

marginal_information_at_common_point._note: 1/var - 1 from the Gauss-Newton covariance diagonal, both evaluated at the same parameter point so only the observed reaches differ.

_caveats: Singular vectors are mixtures of the five parameters; ordered singular values must not be relabelled as named parameters.
H = J^T J + I is an approximate local linearisation, not a calibrated posterior.
One fixed storage spatial mode; snapshot algebra only, with no time integration.
Half the storage contributions at truth are negative (32,296 of 64,579) with zero negative total fluxes; nothing is clipped.
Guaranteeing nonnegative total flux across the tested box caps |delta_Sc| at 7.7% of a reach's equilibrium chemical mass.
The storage physics — the placement of Phi, the sign structure and the meaning of delta_Sc — remains open for review.

source_bias_stress_test._design: The 90-gauge case reproduced bit-for-bit, then refitted with ONE change: the fitting forward model multiplies every local chemical input Rc by 1.20 at all 64,579 reaches. Observations, water, K, X and the truth field are unchanged.
_caveats: Both the decay field AND the concentration fit got worse; this is not a case where a good concentration fit hides a bad decay field.
One bias size, one sign, one seed, one spatially uniform multiplicative form.

The run does not separate 'a decay field cannot deliver a uniform log offset' from 'the L2 weight penalty resisted'; a uniform error is plausibly a favourable case for detection rather than a representative one.
The chemical input stays known and fixed in the fit, so this is not joint estimation of inputs and decay.

test_suites._note: Suite runs from different sessions overlap and MUST NOT be summed.
